candidates.change_summary: Removed the overflow-protecting assert and replaced it with no check, allowing deposits to always add msg.value to balance.
Reordered statements: first increase the balance, then assert the new balance is greater than the old (assert will always pass unless overflow occurs after add).
Changed the assert condition to check strictly greater than or equal, making it weaker and allowing zero-value deposits to pass differently.
Inserted a revert when msg.value is zero, preventing zero-value deposits from changing state.
Swap the order of transfer and balance decrement so the balance is decreased after sending funds (vulnerable to reentrancy).
Remove the balance decrement so the contract does not reduce the caller's balance after withdrawal (enables repeated withdrawals).
Change the require condition to allow withdrawing strictly less than the stored balance (disallow withdrawing the exact balance).
Invert the require to forbid withdrawing amounts less than or equal to balance, allowing only overdraft-like behavior when amount > balance (will revert for normal cases).
Change transfer to send funds to the contract creator instead of the caller, altering who receives the withdrawn funds.
